question: What happens when a client calls your A P I?

scenes.sub: From the browser to the database and back.
scenes.say: What happens when a client calls your A P I? Interviewers love this one, because every answer shows how much of the stack you really understand.

scenes.head: Think of a restaurant
scenes.say: Picture a restaurant. The diner is the client, and orders something. The host desk sends the order to a free kitchen. That is the load balancer. The kitchen cooks. That is your app server. And when the kitchen needs ingredients, it goes to the pantry. That is the database.

scenes.head: The real journey of one request

items.text: T C P + T L S

scenes.say: Now the real steps. The client calls api dot example dot com. D N S turns that name into an I P address, like a phone book. Then the client opens a T C P connection and does a T L S handshake, so everything is encrypted. The load balancer picks one healthy server. The app server runs your handler. And the handler asks the database for the row.

scenes.head: Inside the app server
scenes.say: The router matches the path and calls your function. One query goes to the database. No row means we return four oh four. Otherwise we turn the row into J S O N and send back two hundred.

scenes.head: See where the time goes
scenes.say: You can measure each stage with curl. Each number is cumulative, in seconds. Here D N S took twelve milliseconds, the connection and handshake most of the rest, and the app only a few more. That tells you whether to blame the network or the code.

scenes.head: In the interview
rows: Spread traffic, survive a dead server
One server is a single point of failure
Encrypts traffic, proves the server's identity
Handshake costs a round trip, so reuse connections
Time each hop, then fix the biggest
Skipping D N S and T L S
Saying only: the server returns J S O N
scenes.say: Likely follow-ups. Why a load balancer? To spread traffic and survive a dead server. Why T L S? It encrypts traffic and proves who the server is. If it is slow, time each hop and fix the biggest. The common mistake is to skip D N S and T L S, and only say the server returns J S O N.

lines: D N S, T C P and T L S, load balancer, app, database, and back.
If it is slow, I time each hop first.
scenes.say: D N S, then T C P and T L S, then the load balancer, the app, the database, and the response back. If it is slow, I time each hop first.
